title: L'ARPCE présente son livre blanc et restitue le projet d'adressage postal numérique
why: Wapi-Yo digital address platform put in service; water, electricity and security services named as beneficiaries; coverage to be extended.

title: Livre Blanc et adressage postal : l'ARPCE pose les fondations de l'État numérique
why: Project since April 2022, legal framework since July 2025; address to be interoperable with identity and payments.

title: Congo/Poste : Le trafic postal en hausse de 50 % au cours des trois premiers trimestres 2025
why: Decree 2025-317 establishing the national postal code system said to be in force.

title: Le Congo adopte enfin un code postal national
why: Council of ministers adopts postal codification decree; lack of official street numbering in Brazzaville districts.

title: Economie postale : la révolution de l'adressage national touche au but
why: Address database platform demonstrated; steering committee of post, civil security, cadastre, mairie; use for utility connections.

title: Congo : Le projet d'adressage postal de l'ARPCE est prêt
why: Secure address database project completed in stages; system to be presented to authorities.

title: Géolocalisation : l'ARPCE met en place un système d'adressage postal
why: Regulator states there is no generalised addressing system, no postcode, no address database.

title: Adressage de la ville océane : les plaques de rues sans numéros
why: Pointe-Noire street naming done on part of the city; plates lack house numbers.
